o.text: Ultimately from Middle Chinese 對 (twojᴴ). Akin to Persian تای (tāy), Russian тай (taj), and the first part of Georgian თაიგული (taiguli).
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish طاتلو (datlu). By surface analysis, dad + -lı.
Borrowed from Russian фала́нга (falánga), from Ancient Greek φάλαγξ (phálanx).
Borrowed from Russian аплика́та (aplikáta), ultimately from Latin applicata.
